# ADR-3067: A06: Direct Git dependency URL for build 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Mutable Git refs bypass review and hashing.

## Decision

Builds SHALL NOT fetch a direct Git dependency URL for build 7 (A06-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Prefer versioned registries with digests.
